21: 25: 26: ### README.md 1: # Car Info -Android Automotive App- 2: 3: This is a sample Android Automotive App, it uses the different car apis and UI elements built spesifically for automotive, to access the differents sensors and VHAL properties for the car. 4: 5: ## Screenshots 6:

7: [](screenshots/screenshot1.png) 10:

11: [](screenshots/screenshot2.png) 14:

15: [](screenshots/screenshot3.png) 18:

19: [](screenshots/screenshot4.gif) 22: 23: ## Setup 24: Clone this repository and import into **Android Studio** 25: ```bash 26: git clone https://github.com/islem19/Android-Automotive-Info-App.git 27: ``` 28: 29: ## Car UI Lib 30: The car UI lib is part of the android automotive OS source code (AOSP) and it contains the different UI elements implemented and designed to spesifically run on the car infotainment system and adhere to the UI/UX of the Android Automotive OS. the lib isn't available for public to include it as gradle dependency, so it should be included manually as a module and build alongside the app. 31: 32: 33: ## Permissions 34: The App requires the following permissions: 35: -Car speed: this permission is required to access to the car speed property. 36: -Car powertrain: this permission is required to access to the car gear selection property. 37: -Car energy: this permission is required to access to the car level and type of fuel property. 38: -Car energy Ports: this permission is required to access to the car fuel ports property. 39: -Car Info: this permission is required to access to the car information (manufactrure, VIN, model..) property. 40: -Car exterior environment: this permission necessary to read temperature of car's exterior environment 41: 42: 43: ## Maintainers 44: This project is mantained by: 45: * [Abdelkader Sellami](https://github.com/islem19) 46: 47: 48: ## Contributing 49: 50: 1. Fork it 51: 2. Create your feature branch (git checkout -b my-new-feature) 52: 3. Commit your changes (git commit -m 'Add some feature') 53: 4. Push your branch (git push origin my-new-feature) 54: 5. Create a new Pull Request 55: 56: 57: ## License 58: This application is released under GNU GPLv3 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). Some of the used libraries are released under different licenses. ### provenance/UPSTREAM.md 1: # Upstream provenance 2: 3: - `https://github.com/marianosalvetti/Android-Automotive-Info-App` at `102ff3378b2e893d27cd36b6e8d91af338ce7ba0` (primary app and car-ui-lib; root GPL-3.0) 4: - `https://git.codelinaro.org/clo/la/platform/packages/services/Car` at `0be103dc50a93e57ff6e0e8064f35f30df8c9e79` (selected Apache-2.0 property API/HAL/service/test sources) 5: 6: The root GPL-3.0 license is preserved. Apache-2.0 component headers remain in the selected AAOS 7: files. Local adaptation removes auxiliary Soong test metadata, declares one Gradle platform module, 8: and adds only product branch configuration. Generated `aidl_api`, binaries and unrelated services 9: are excluded. Local branches are generic benchmark evolution, not upstream vendor releases.

  15: class CarManager(private val car : Car) {

  17: 
  18:     private val fuelLevel : Subject<Float> by lazy { PublishSubject.create() }

  27:     val evChargePortObservable : Observable<Boolean>
  28:         get() = evChargePort
  29: 
  30:     private val fuelLevelLow : Subject<Boolean> by lazy { PublishSubject.create() }
  31:     val fuelLevelLowObservable : Observable<Boolean>
  32:         get() = fuelLevelLow
  33: 
  34:     private val speedCar : Subject<Int> by lazy { PublishSubject.create() }
  35:     val speedCarObservable : Observable<Int>
  36:         get() = speedCar
  37: 
  38:     private val gearSelected : Subject<String> by lazy { PublishSubject.create() }
  39:     val gearSelectedObservable : Observable<String>
  40:         get() = gearSelected
  41: 
  42:     private val batteryLevel : Subject<Float> by lazy { PublishSubject.create() }
  43:     val batteryLevelObservable : Observable<Float>
  44:         get() = batteryLevel
  45: 
  46:     @RequiresPermission(allOf = [
  47:         "android.car.permission.CAR_POWERTRAIN",
  48:         "android.car.permission.CAR_SPEED",
  49:         "android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY",
  50:         "android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY_PORTS"])
  51:     fun init(){
  52:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_LEVEL, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  53:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_DOOR_OPEN, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  54:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_LEVEL_LOW, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  55:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.PERF_VEHICLE_SPEED, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  56:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.GEAR_SELECTION, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  57:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.EV_BATTERY_LEVEL, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  58:         carPropertyManager.registerCallback(carPropertyCallback, VehiclePropertyIds.EV_CHARGE_PORT_OPEN, CarPropertyManager.SENSOR_RATE_NORMAL)
  59:     }

  61:     fun cleanCallback(){
  62:         carPropertyManager.unregisterCallback(carPropertyCallback)

  64: 
  65:     private val carPropertyCallback = object : CarPropertyManager.CarPropertyEventCallback {
  66:         override fun onChangeEvent(carPropertvalue: CarPropertyValue<*>?) {
  67:             when(carPropertvalue?.propertyId){
  68:                 VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_LEVEL -> {
  69:                     val fuelPercent = (carPropertvalue.value as Float) * 100 / getFuelCapacity()
  70:                     fuelLevel.onNext(fuelPercent)
  71:                 }
  72:                 VehiclePropertyIds.EV_BATTERY_LEVEL -> {
  73:                     val batteryPercent = (carPropertvalue.value as Float) * 100 / getBatteryCapacity()
  74:                     batteryLevel.onNext(batteryPercent)
  75:                 }
  76:                 VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_DOOR_OPEN -> fuelDoor.onNext(carPropertvalue.value as Boolean)
  77:                 VehiclePropertyIds.EV_CHARGE_PORT_OPEN -> evChargePort.onNext(carPropertvalue.value as Boolean)
  78:                 VehiclePropertyIds.FUEL_LEVEL_LOW -> fuelLevelLow.onNext(carPropertvalue.value as Boolean)
  79:                 VehiclePropertyIds.PERF_VEHICLE_SPEED -> {
  80:                     // convert speed from sensor (m/s) to (km/h)
  81:                     val speedKmH = (carPropertvalue.value as Float) * 3600 / 1000
  82:                     speedCar.onNext(speedKmH.toInt())
  83:                 }
  84:                 VehiclePropertyIds.GEAR_SELECTION -> {
  85:                     val gear = GearType.forType(carPropertvalue.value as Int)
  86:                     gearSelected.onNext(gear)
  87:                 }
  88:             }
  89:         }
  90: 
  91:         override fun onErrorEvent(propertyId: Int, zone: Int) = Unit
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     @RequiresPermission(allOf = ["android.car.permission.CAR_INFO"])
  95:     fun getFuelType() : String {
  96:         var fuel = ""
  97:         val fuelTypes = getCarPropertyValue<Array<Int>>(VehiclePropertyIds.INFO_FUEL_TYPE,VehicleAreaType.VEHICLE_AREA_TYPE_GLOBAL)
  98:         fuelTypes.forEach {
  99:             fuel = "$fuel ${FuelType.values()[it].name}"
 100:         }
 101:         return fuel
 102:     }
